In an art exhibition, four artists—Alice, Bob, Carol, and David—each have created various art pieces that can be displayed under different themes at different times. </scenario>

Let x(i, j, k) mean artist i's piece is exhibited under theme j at time slot k. Here, artist 0 is Alice, artist 1 is Bob, artist 2 is Carol, and artist 3 is David.
